text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and U.N. agree on all conditions to pave the way for the implementation of the oil-for-food deal.
- UAE moving towards dialogue with Iraq.
- Boutros-Ghali is optimistic about oil-for-food deal.
- Albright says U.S. to respond positively on the pricing formula regarding partial oil exports by Iraq.
- Oil prices fall on world markets.
- Turkey seeking new outlets to solve its energy crisis.
- Commentary lashes out at Rolf Ekeus, chairman of U.N. Special Commission on Iraq for his Gulf tour.
- Iraqi dinar soars and the U.S. dollar tumbles on oil news.
- Oil overseers to arrive in Iraq next week.
- Washington pulls out 5,000 agents from northern Iraq.
- More foreign companies line up for trade with Iraq.
